Title: Built-in support for Apache Spark in Azure Cosmos DB now in preview

Body.Content:
Run globally distributed, low latency operational analytics and AI on transactional data within your database. By using built-in support for Apache Spark and Jupyter notebooks, Azure Cosmos DB helps reduce time to insights by ingesting and serving data and running analytics against the local database replica in an Azure region. Directly execute Spark queries on indexed multi-model data stored within your data partitions, without any unnecessary data movement.

Learn more
